description.value: Kinton Ramen UBC is a location of one of North America's largest ramen chains, situated on the University of British Columbia campus just west of the University Boulevard and Westbrook Mall intersection. The restaurant offers a broad range of soup bases — pork, beef, chicken, and vegetarian — with multiple flavour and noodle options, and a patio for outdoor seating. It is part of a Canadian chain founded in 2012 with over 50 locations across five provinces and two countries.
